process.heading: How I work

steps.title: Conversation
steps.text: We talk about goals, audience and what's needed – and what isn't.

steps.title: Design in Figma
steps.text: I draw up the design in Figma so you can see it and give feedback.

steps.title: Development
steps.text: The design becomes code. You follow along and see progress continuously.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: The site goes live – and I'm still around if you need help afterwards.

process.engagement: I take on work as an hourly consultant, as defined projects or as an extra pair of hands in your team – on site in Östergötland or remotely.

about.paragraph1: I'm Josefine and I run Kod & Design. I'm a UI designer and full-stack developer with a focus on frontend, and what I enjoy most is taking an idea all the way from the first sketch in Figma to a finished product in the browser.
about.paragraph2: Because I both design and code, there's no gap between designer and developer – what gets drawn can also be built. I work with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind, and build the backend with Node.js and PostgreSQL when the project needs it.
about.paragraph3: Clear communication, realistic timelines and delivering what I promise – that's the foundation of everything I do.

pricing.title: Pricing & Packages
pricing.subtitle: We tailor the setup to your needs. Every project starts with a free consultation where we put together a quote.

oneTime.title: One-off Project
oneTime.description: We build your website or application for a fixed price. You get the source code and take over after delivery – no ongoing commitment.

hosting.title: Project + Hosting
hosting.description: We build the project and manage hosting for you – Vercel, S3 bucket for media and similar – all on your own account and billed to you. You only pay the actual costs plus a small administration fee.

items.title: Advance payment
items.text: 30–50% of the project price is invoiced at project start. The remaining amount is invoiced upon delivery.

items.title: Changes outside scope
items.text: Changes beyond the agreed scope are billed hourly. We always inform you before starting any additional work.

items.title: Ownership
items.text: Ownership of the code transfers to you upon full payment. Until then, Kod & Design owns the code.

items.title: Cancellation
items.text: If the project is cancelled, work completed up to that point is billed at the agreed hourly rate.

items.title: Payment
items.text: Payment terms are 30 days net unless otherwise agreed.

items.title: GDPR
